fields.notes: GAP CLOSED. Instantaneous per-node write-back MB/s (governor.nodes[].replaceProgress.mbps) is now summed and persisted each poll as the tdarr.writeback.mbps metric, giving a real time-series. Empty state remains valid until history accumulates; must still render an explicit empty state (no fabricated line) when the series is empty. CONSTRAINT: the read query src/lib/panels/queries.ts::metricSeries is resolution-blind (selects by box+metric+time window, no resolution filter). Safe for the 60-min panel window because collapse only touches rows older than 24h, so raw is the only resolution inside the window; but any future consumer widening the window past 24h must add a resolution filter to avoid double-counting raw + hour rows. Deferred per-node throughput series (tdarr.writeback.mbps.<node>) should land together with that fix.
